title: AHA!: Facilitating AI Impact Assessment by Generating Examples of Harms

bias_targets.methodology: Eliciting potential harms by prompting crowdworkers and an LLM (GPT-3) with scenario-based vignettes featuring stakeholders who identify as racial minorities, followed by thematic analysis to code for harms like unfair treatment and reinforcing stereotypes.

Eliciting potential harms by prompting crowdworkers and an LLM (GPT-3) with scenario-based vignettes featuring stakeholders who identify as ethnic minorities, followed by thematic analysis to identify representational and allocational harms.

Eliciting potential harms by prompting crowdworkers and an LLM (GPT-3) with scenario-based vignettes featuring stakeholders who identify as women, and analyzing the generated descriptions for biases such as unfair treatment and stereotyping.

Prompting crowdworkers and an LLM with vignettes specifically featuring stakeholders who identify as both women and racial or ethnic minorities to surface harms affecting individuals with overlapping marginalized identities.
